# Sales Strategy & Operations - Central
Company: OpenAI
Tracker ID: openai_sales_strategy_operations_central
Location: San Francisco, CA
Work arrangement: Hybrid, three days per week in office
Salary range: $190,000-$245,000
Posting date: 2026-07-29

## Job Description
Lead sales strategy and operations for the Central region. Build annual planning,
territory design, pipeline governance, forecasting, performance reporting, and
cross-functional operating rhythms for Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Revenue
Operations. Translate go-to-market priorities into measurable execution and
clear executive decisions.

## Qualifications
Experience in sales operations, revenue operations, territory planning,
forecasting, pipeline management, executive communication, and GTM analytics.
